transcript: These four ChatGPT prompts made me 1 lakh rupees in 7 days. Here's how you can copy me step by step. Prompt 1: Sabse pehle I gave ChatGPT my state and city name, then I asked it to give me the biggest pain points of businesses in my city. Usne mujhe poora research paper bana ke diya. Prompt 2: I gave ChatGPT my income goal, my starting capital, and my skill level. Then I asked it to give me three service ideas jo main unhi businesses ko sell kar sakta hu. These are the three ideas it gave, and I picked the easiest one. Prompt 3: I asked it to give me all the selling points that I can use to get clients. Usne mujhe poore ka poora sales script bana ke diya. Finally, Prompt 4: I asked it to give me all the location and contact details of clients in my city. I took that, went into the market, and talked to 15 to 20 clients. I got 4 clients worth ₹50,000 in just 2 days. In this video, I have documented everything in detail. Agar tumhe dekhna hai, comment karo Prompt, and I will share it with you.
